# ALBA: BRUNCH • COFFEE • MATCHA BAR (Alba Lisbon)

Also known as: Alba Lisbon, Alba Bistro, Alba Bistro Lisboa

> Brunch café, specialty coffee and ceremonial matcha bar with a sunny terrace at Largo do Rato, Lisbon. Open every day 9:00–17:00.

- Address: Largo do Rato, 4A, 1250-186 Lisboa, Portugal (Rato metro station)
- Hours: Monday – Sunday, 9:00 – 17:00; lunch on weekdays from 12:00
- Email: hello@albalisbon.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/albabistro.lisbon
- Price level: €€ (brunch dishes 9–14 €, coffee 1.50–7 €, matcha drinks 4–6.50 €)

## What we serve

- Brunch beyond avocado toast: omelettes, savory and sweet crêpes, eggs Benedict with salmon or pastrami, croque madame, savory and sweet oatmeal
- Specialty coffee: espresso, batch brew, hand brew, cold brew, signature lattes
- Ceremonial matcha by Michi (Ikigai, Yutori, Haru, Hojicha) as shots, lattes, signature drinks and a three-variety tasting set
- Vegan option: avocado toast with vegan feta; oat milk for any drink
